featured_reviews.review_text: Plz guys don't waste your hard earned money, the service centre is pathetic and so the dealership.l will tell you my experience I bought bike after free service , they sold me AMC worth rs3000 and extended warranty worth rs2500 when I purchased and gave my bike to service they told me today it is full kal morning 8 baje aao , I told them sir due to work I can't come this early you take my scooter and give it to me after 2 days , they told they don't have parking to keep my scooter for service, then I asked what's the solution they told me it's your problem come at 8am or your scooter will not get serviced , I mean I don't have words I spent almost 5500 for amc service package and after selling me package this is how these guys treat. featured_reviews.name: Ankit Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service experience at Aditya Honda. What should have been a simple bike service turned into a frustrating ordeal. The entire setup of EMC feels like a scam designed to trap customers rather than support them.

To begin with, the waiting time is unacceptable—over 90 minutes just to hand over a bike for service. This is not customer service; it is a disaster disguised as one. Time clearly has no value here, as people are casually asked to go back or wait endlessly, with no regard for their schedules or commitments.

Adding to the frustration, Aditya Honda relies on third-party vendors for Honda vehicle parts. This is not only inefficient but also a serious black mark on Honda’s reputation and the Japanese tradition of precision and professionalism. It undermines the very trust customers place in the brand.

I had been considering purchasing a new Honda bike, but after witnessing this level of after-sales negligence, I have completely changed my mind. Having used Honda bikes in multiple countries, I can confidently say that the professionalism I once admired is missing here.

This franchise damages Honda’s image and erodes customer loyalty. I strongly urge Honda to reconsider their association with Aditya Honda. Keeping them as a franchise is not just a bad investment—it is a betrayal of the values Honda claims to stand for.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a Hero Splendor+ XTEC 2.0 from the showroom, and my experience has been extremely disappointing.
The bike is brand new, but as soon as I took it from the showroom, it started giving problems. After just a few kilometers, the bike completely stopped.

When I informed the showroom, instead of giving proper support, the manager simply said:
“Service ke liye lekar aao.”

This is not acceptable for a brand-new bike.
Why should a customer face such issues on Day 1 itself?

A brand-new vehicle should not:
•	Stop after a few kilometers
•	Have starting or engine trouble
•	Require service immediately after purchase

This clearly shows poor quality check and careless delivery by the showroom.

I request Hero and the dealership to:
1.	Check and resolve the issue immediately
2.	Replace faulty parts (if any)
3.	Ensure proper PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection)
4.	Provide clear explanation for the failure

Customers spend hard-earned money and trust the brand.
But this experience has been very frustrating and unfair.

Please take this seriously.

featured_reviews.review_text: Recently visited Fortpoint Automotive Pvt Ltd - Hero MotoCorp and the overall experience was really good. Staff was very polite, supportive and explained every bike model properly. Showroom was clean, well-maintained and customer handling was professional. Test ride process was smooth and all my queries were answered patiently. Great place for anyone planning to buy a Hero bike. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review as a somewhat satisfied customer. I left my Hero Xpulse 200 2V here. My motorcycle was cutting out while riding. I gave my Vehicle on 3oth Nov 2025. I was told the issue was diagnosed and was supposed to pick up my vehicle on 7th of Dec 2025. When I went to the showroom on the decided date, the issue was not resolved. I immediately took it up with the Technician. He immediately started re-verifying the issue and started diagnosing the issue. He started at 10:10 am and He kept at it till 12:00 until my issue was resolved. This is the kind of service and responsibility a customer expects from a Service Centre. Even through the issue was resolved in the one week, the technician took the time again to listen to my feedback and only finished the job after I (as a customer) was satisfied.

I highly recommend this service Centre for people living in VIRAR. One caveat though, Hero Parts timelines are totally unpredictable. Please be weary of their parts delivery timeline. Other than that, the Technicians are soft spoken, and take care of customers really well. I wish them Good luck.
